items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: From Booker’s transmission... he also told me... He was writing this suite for Coleman Hawkins... Coleman Hawkins knew what he was.

ctx.x: Coleman Hawkins was out in California doing that Central Avenue time for some

time, and he was living in a rooming house over there, and he liked this scotch and stuff. Well he would come home at night in his Chrysler, whatever he was driving - he always like Chryslers - and summertime he’d have the windows down and his tenor on the back seat! And he’d go up and go to bed!
